subject: general
question: Tulsidas Borkar, who was awarded with the Padma Shri in 2016, was a _________ player.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harmonium.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Borkar** made a name for himself as an accomplished **harmonium player** and was conferred with the Padma Shri award in 2016.
 
• He was also a recipient of the** Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.**
 
• Borkar was known for both **solo performances as well as his unique style** of accompanying Indian classical singers.
 
• **Pandit Tulsidas Borkar **had been diagnosed with tuberculosis and was treated in Mumbai's Nanavati Hospital.
 
• But, due to old age, his body **didn't respond well to the treatment.**
 
• He died at the age of 83 on** 29 September 2018 at 10:20 A.M. in Mumbai.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6225821b3ec0a78739ae64f5fee5fbae913d7bb748585e00fa2d61dd19ae5ac8.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** nadaswaram** is a **wind instrument** made of wood and metal that is found in both classical and folk traditions in South India. 
 
• The sound of shehnai can be described as **a cross between an oboe and a muted trumpet**.
 
• A **bansuri** is an ancient side-blown flute originating from the Indian subcontinent.
